body:
Tested this, it's not super intuitive.

Our install script sets things up like this:
```
$ ls bin/build_deps/
agility_sdk  mesa-arm64-llvm  mesa-arm64-msvc  mesa-x86_32-gcc  mesa-x86_32-llvm  mesa-x86_32-msvc  mesa-x86_64-gcc  mesa-x86_64-llvm  mesa-x86_64-msvc  pix
```

So to use this auto-detection of the arch/toolchain, you need to specify `mesa_libs=/path/to/bin/build_deps/mesa`, which isn't a folder so it's a bit confusing.

(We have logic to autodetect that path too but in case users need to specify it manually for some reason, this is unintuitive.)

Maybe we can do the setup as
```
bin/build_deps/mesa/
bin/build_deps/mesa/x86_64-gcc/
bin/build_deps/mesa/x86_64-llvm/
bin/build_deps/mesa/x86_64-msvc/
```
etc. so it's more obvious to give the path to the parent folder.

The most convenient would probably be to set up this structure directly in a single zip release on https://github.com/godotengine/godot-nir-static so we can just extract it without having to post-process it too much, and better support use cases where people would download the release manually in a different location?
